name: Get active connection count
description: Get active connection count Get the number of active connections for one or more Postgres databases or Redis instances. GET /v1/metrics/active-connections
context:
GET /v1/metrics/active-connections
Get the number of active connections for one or more Postgres databases or Redis instances.
Optional: startTime (query) — Epoch/Unix timestamp of start of time range to return. Defaults to `now() - 1 hour`.; endTime (query) — Epoch/Unix timestamp of end of time range to return. Defaults to `now()`.; resource (query) — Resource ID to query. When multiple resource query params are provided, they are ORed together. Resources Postgres ids or Redis ids

name: Get bandwidth usage breakdown by traffic source
description: Get bandwidth usage breakdown by traffic source Get bandwidth usage for one or more resources broken down by traffic source (HTTP, WebSocket, NAT, PrivateLink). GET /v1/metrics/bandwidth-sources
context:
GET /v1/metrics/bandwidth-sources
Get bandwidth usage for one or more resources broken down by traffic source (HTTP, WebSocket, NAT, PrivateLink). Returns hourly data points with traffic source breakdown. Traffic source data is available from March 9, 2025 onwards. Queries for earlier dates will return a 400 Bad Request error.
Optional: startTime (query) — Epoch/Unix timestamp of start of time range to return. Defaults to `now() - 1 hour`.; endTime (query) — Epoch/Unix timestamp of end of time range to return. Defaults to `now()`.

name: Get CPU usage

context:

Optional: startTime (query) — Epoch/Unix timestamp of start of time range to return. Defaults to `now() - 1 hour`.; endTime (query) — Epoch/Unix timestamp of end of time range to return. Defaults to `now()`.; resolutionSeconds (query) — The resolution of the returned data; resource (query) — Resource ID to query. When multiple resource query params are provided, they are ORed together. Resources can be service ids, Postgres ids, or Redis ids; service (query) — This parameter is deprecated. Please use `resource` instead; instance (query) — Instance ID to query. When multiple instance ID query params are provided, they are ORed together; aggregationMethod (query) — The aggregation method to apply to multiple time series
